calls.title: Reo investigation
calls.summary: The team discussed improving lead scoring by utilizing the Rio platform to identify promising leads beyond traditional demo requests. They targeted specific geographic regions, including the US and Western Europe, and focused on personas like Product Managers and Engineers. Manual outreach efforts are time-intensive, currently allowing for about 50 calls daily, with a proposal to increase that to 70–75 for better results. There are challenges in upselling Pro customers to Enterprise plans due to cost objections, with only two meetings held so far. Additionally, the tracking and deal creation process in HubSpot requires improvements for better visibility and accountability. Current inbound lead management is effectively handled by Account Executives but may necessitate an SDR layer if volume increases.
calls.keywords: Lead Scoring, Rio Platform, SDR Outreach, Apollo Sequences, Pro to Enterprise Conversion, Inbound vs Outbound Sales
calls.action_items:
**Jeff Ignacio**
Investigate options to increase Jake’s daily call volume towards 70-75 by introducing automation and curated lead lists (21:30)
Nurture discussion with Ryan on potential adjustments to inbound SDR support if inbound volumes increase, including possible team expansion (19:30)

**Jake Stangl**
Continue current outreach using Rio segments focusing on Hypo surging and Hypo accounts, refining sequence messaging with pain point-driven questions per Jeff’s suggestions (12:30)
Improve deal tracking by creating deals in HubSpot upon meeting booking to ensure proper attribution and performance visibility (16:50)
Maintain integration between outreach tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and HubSpot to ensure all contacts and communications are logged (06:40)

**Ryan**
Provide updated and automated curated lead lists to Jake to enable higher outbound call volumes (21:30)
